source.title: Che senso ha questa busta paga

notes: Image of a payslip a worker posted on Reddit, collected by the maintainer; transcribed as printed. Name, tax code, employer and any bank or registration number are not transcribed.
The right edge is cropped: competenze and trattenute totals are cut; the pay elements are the full-time amounts.

replay.reason: A 50% part-time fixed-term worker: the paga base and contingenza printed are full-time monthly rates, not the amounts paid; the headcount up to 15 was inferred from the FIS rate printed, so the INPS rate cannot be compared either.
